scope: Per-device analytical full-stack placement contract: 30 decoder layers (25 sliding, 5 full), persistent decoder weights, BF16 KV cache, persistent all-reduce resources, mandatory downstream terminal weights/final norm, configured trace region, conservative source-live prefill tensors, and allocator reserve; excludes serving-only allocations

terminal_contract.status: mandatory downstream full-model placement contract; not implemented by this decoder stage

source_lifetime_contract.status: conservative: no deallocation credit is taken unless explicit in source
prefill_sources: MultichipDecoder._attention_prefill creates full-length QKV before dispatching chunked SDPA
MultichipDecoder._prefill_full_attention and _prefill_sliding_attention retain output chunks through ttnn.concat
OptimizedDecoder._prefill_forward_single_user retains the residual and branch outputs through attention and FFN
OptimizedDecoder._moe_prefill retains full outer residual/branch tensors while processing 1024-token expert chunks
source_lifetime_contract.attention_output_reduce_peak_formula: outer_hidden_count*H + 2*QKV_local + Q_local + RoPE + caller_padding_copies; outer_hidden_count is 4 on TP1 and 5 when a TP all-reduce output is live
source_lifetime_contract.dense_mlp_peak_formula: outer_hidden_count*H + 5*dense_local + RoPE + caller_padding_copies; outer_hidden_count is 6 on TP1 and 7 on TP2/TP4
source_lifetime_contract.moe_peak_formula: (outer_hidden_count+2)*H + H_chunk + 3*grouped_local + 2*dispatch + router + RoPE + 2*router_chunk + caller_padding_copies; outer_hidden_count is 7 with shared FFN norm and 8 for the TP4/full exception, and the two additional H tensors are accumulated output chunks plus the concat result
source_lifetime_contract.nonaligned_caller_padding_formula: logical_tokens*(hidden_size + 2*rope_head_dim)*2 when logical_tokens is not tile aligned; the caller still owns the original hidden/cos/sin tensors while padded replacements are live
source_lifetime_contract.allocator_reserve_policy: preserve the prior profile-specific allocator slack in addition to the configured trace region and the full conservative source-live activation peak

disabled_profiles.P150: hard capacity limit: the 16176906240-byte all-BFP8 retained copy exceeds decoder-stage headroom; even an unselected all-BFP4 lower bound is 8564244480 bytes
disabled_profiles.P150x2: capacity overrides decode speed: the 8088453120-byte retained copy would make the conservative 262144-token full-stack projection exceed 32 GiB

P150.precision_exception: BF16 sliding-attention projections; BFP8 full-attention, dense, and expert projections except BFP4 expert gate/up on the five full-attention layers

P150x2.proxy: two-device 1x2 submesh of a four-P300C QB2 FABRIC_2D parent

notes: TP4 full attention duplicates one KV head per rank pair because two global KV heads cannot be quarter-sharded.
The TP1 BFP4 exception is capacity-required and is accuracy-gated by representative full-attention prefill/decode PCC; broader expert-down BFP4 candidates failed the PCC gate.
The previous BF16 terminal control alone needs 2952790016 bytes on TP1 and exceeds the selected full-stack capacity contract.
BFP8_B terminal storage uses physical tile accounting, including the per-tile exponent overhead; it is not approximated as one byte per element.
The BFP8_B terminal policy is capacity-mandated here but needs terminal/logit correctness evidence in the downstream full-model stage.
Packed expert decode retains a distinct gate/up tensor per layer in addition to separate prefill weights; capacity disables it on TP1 and TP2 and selects it only on TP4.

TP1 cannot support advertised 262144-token prefill under the correctness-proven precision policy: the conservative full-stack projection is 56398546944 bytes. Its largest contiguous analytical contract is 50624 tokens; 50623 is the tighter nonaligned boundary and 50625 is the first rejected candidate.
TP2 and TP4 retain the advertised 262144-token contract with 788749312 and 939828224 bytes of conservative headroom, respectively.
